entities.relationship: Starbucks dispone de buscadores oficiales por mercado.
La ubicación o una dirección manual establece el punto de búsqueda.
La búsqueda para un viaje a Alemania debe usar la ciudad alemana concreta.
El localizador del país enlaza a las fichas de sus cafeterías.
Google Maps permite buscar una cafetería y calcular la ruta.
Una dirección explícita permite buscar sin usar la ubicación actual.
El horario pertenece a una sucursal y a un día concretos.
La etiqueta de apertura debe comprobarse contra la hora de llegada.
El medio de transporte cambia el recorrido y la duración estimada.
La ruta a pie se consulta con ese modo seleccionado.
España tiene un buscador oficial en español.
Los resultados de estos directorios de México no son una lista alemana.
La apertura dominical no se puede generalizar a toda la cadena.
Un horario habitual no confirma la apertura en festivo.
El pedido anticipado requiere la app, inicio de sesión y una tienda participante.
No debe darse por supuesta la compatibilidad internacional de una cuenta.
El reparto se comprueba con la dirección de entrega.
La ficha de compra elegida es la referencia para el pedido concreto.
Una ficha puede indicar wifi sin garantizar asientos o enchufes.
Las funciones de mapas descargados son limitadas.
La entrada física y la accesibilidad deben comprobarse para el viaje.
No se confirma disponibilidad local.
No se usa una promoción no comprobada.

information_gain: Spanish-language guide for Germany with country-selector table, German-to-Spanish label glossary and scenario decision matrix. Prevents confusion between cafe location and delivery catchment.

de_locator.title: Finde ein Coffee House - Suche | Starbucks
de_locator.facts: Official interactive locator; location entry. No complete personalized result set was exposed.

es_locator.title: Encontrar una tienda - Buscar | Starbucks
es_locator.facts: Official Spanish locator; manual location field. Not a guarantee that a Spanish-language query means the reader is in Spain.

us_locator.title: Café Locator: Starbucks Coffee Company
us_locator.facts: US locator with pickup/delivery controls; supplemental SERP page, not a global directory.

sucursales.title: Starbucks Cerca de Mi - Todas las Sucursales
sucursales.facts: Mexico directory; geographic position prompt and city list. Not Germany coverage.

firmania.title: Buscar ubicaciones de Starbucks cerca de mí | Firmania
firmania.facts: Spain directory with addresses and opening-status displays. Its footer states third-party data limitations.

rappi.title: Starbucks cerca de mi - Rappi
rappi.facts: Mexico delivery directory asks for delivery address. Visible count changed between search and page retrieval; not used as store count.

kettwiger.title: Essen Kettwiger Strasse 2-10 | Starbucks
kettwiger.facts: Kettwiger Strasse 2–10, 45127 Essen. Mon–Fri 07:30–20:00; Sat 08:00–20:30; Sun 10:00–19:00. Lists Wi-Fi, reward redemption and mobile ordering.

limbecker.title: Essen, Limbecker Platz | Starbucks
limbecker.facts: Limbecker Platz 1a. Mon–Thu 09:00–20:00; Fri–Sat 09:00–20:30; Sun closed. Lists Wi-Fi, reward redemption and mobile ordering.

hbf_locator.title: Essen Hauptbahnhof | Starbucks
hbf_locator.facts: Am Hauptbahnhof 5. Mon–Fri 05:30–21:00; Sat–Sun 07:00–21:00. Lists Wi-Fi, reward redemption and mobile ordering. Conflicts with DB; neither source independently establishes actual hours.

hbf_db.title: Starbucks – Essen Hbf
hbf_db.facts: Ground floor. Mon–Fri 06:00–21:30; Sat 09:00–21:30; Sun including holidays 06:30–21:00. Cash, Girocard, Mastercard, Visa and American Express. Conflicts with Starbucks locator.

station.title: Essen Hbf | Deutsche Bahn
station.facts: Station address Am Hauptbahnhof 5, 45127 Essen. Provides station map, departure information, accessibility and lift status resources.

center.title: Öffnungszeiten | Limbecker Platz Essen
center.facts: Center Mon–Sat 10:00–20:00; Sunday closed. Starbucks separately Mon–Sat 09:00–20:00. Conflicts with Starbucks Friday/Saturday closing time. Center advises contacting individual shops.

kaufda.title: Starbucks Filialen in Essen - Adressen & Öffnungszeiten
kaufda.facts: Directory lists Theaterplatz 1, Am Hauptbahnhof 5 and Limbecker Platz 1a. Theaterplatz was not independently confirmed as a separate current branch; do not claim closure or relocation.

wolt.title: Starbucks - Essen | Wolt
wolt.facts: Delivery index contains Kettwiger Strasse, Hauptbahnhof and Limbecker Platz. Neighborhood links are delivery areas, not proof of separate stores.

maps_search.title: Search locations on Google Maps
maps_search.facts: Can search by business, address, city and postcode. Filters vary by country/language; details include hours and website. Ranking is not strictly nearest first.

maps_nearby.title: Search for nearby places and explore the area
maps_nearby.facts: Nearby search can be anchored to a place/address. Local results combine relevance, distance and prominence; data from multiple sources.

maps_routes.title: Obtener indicaciones y mostrar rutas en Google Maps
maps_routes.facts: Select start, destination and transport mode. Durations are estimates; driving and walking routes differ.

maps_location.title: Encontrar tu ubicación y mejorar la precisión en Google Maps
maps_location.facts: Location permissions and the blue location indicator help check the origin; accuracy can vary.

maps_offline.title: Descargar zonas y navegar sin conexión en Google Maps
maps_offline.facts: Downloadable areas; offline restrictions include no walking/cycling/transit directions and no live traffic. Do not promise fresh opening hours offline.

mop.title: FAQ zu Mobile Order & Pay
mop.facts: App and Rewards sign-in required; participating stores identified in locator. Prepared order is collected in chosen store. No additional service fee; product availability and preparation vary.

card.title: FAQ zur Starbucks® Card
card.facts: Card acceptance limited to participating German stores; licensed exceptions. Does not establish universal cross-border account/card interoperability.

food.title: FAQ zu Getränken und Speisen
food.facts: General menu can have short-term stock gaps. Vegan food and plant drinks available in range. Links to current nutrition and allergens; no medical/allergen-safety inference.

menu.title: Order - Menu | Starbucks
menu.facts: Menu categories: espresso, tea, Frappuccino, chocolate; desserts, sandwiches, snacks. No verified branch-specific price list.

delivery.title: Starbucks Delivers
delivery.facts: Official German delivery partners: Uber Eats, Wolt, Lieferando. No claim every address served.

delivery_faq.title: FAQ Delivers | Starbucks
delivery_faq.facts: Supplemental delivery FAQ; used only where specific text was inspected. Delivery price/availability checked at ordering stage.
